character.name: Idle
character.prompt:
Plaintext
Pixel art character sprite of a supreme Royal Knight Holy Fusion warrior inspired by Omegamon / Omnimon, heroic upright battle stance, three-quarter front view.

Visual Design:
- Body & Armor: Slender, tall humanoid knight body in pure white Chrome Digizoid plate armor, gold filigree trim, segmented black-and-gold waist, and a long flowing dual-tone cape (pure white outside, vibrant crimson-red inside) billowing behind the shoulders.
- Head & Helm: Elegant white cyber-knight helmet crowned with sharp golden v-shaped antenna horns, sharp blue visor eye-slits, and a pointed golden forehead crest.
- Left Arm (WarGreymon Dragon Head): Massive golden-and-orange horned dragon skull shoulder armor and gauntlet, jaw open extending a colossal, polished silver two-handed broadsword (Grey Sword) with glowing golden digi-code engraved along the blade.
- Right Arm (MetalGarurumon Wolf Head): Sleek metallic navy-and-silver cyber-wolf head shoulder armor and gauntlet, jaws housing a massive high-tech blue-and-gold railgun / laser cannon barrel (Garuru Cannon).
- Legs & Sabatons: Slender white armored greaves with sharp gold knee guards, black inner mechanical joints, and pointed white-and-gold armored sabatons.

Style Specifications:
- 32-bit crisp RPG pixel art sprite, 64x64 or 128x128 canvas resolution.
- High-contrast metallic reflections, clean bold dark pixel outlines, vibrant white, gold, crimson, and cobalt-blue color palette.
- Centered full-body sprite isolated on a clean transparent background.
